event_records.description: Ravi sees the listing for the 2019 hatchback and considers making an offer.

ravi.name: Ravi
ravi.persona_brief:
You are Ravi.
Ravi wants to buy a 2019 hatchback. He has a maximum budget of 40,000 rupees less than the seller's listed price. He is willing to negotiate and can make an offer.

seller.name: Seller
seller.persona_brief:
You are Seller.
The seller has listed a 2019 hatchback at a certain price. They are willing to negotiate but have a minimum acceptable price that is 40,000 rupees above Ravi's budget. The listing expires in three days.

resolution.question: Ravi and the private seller of a 2019 hatchback are 40,000 rupees apart. Will they agree on a price in the three days before the seller's posted listing expires?
resolution.resolution: Resolve YES if, before the cutoff, the persistent event history shows that Ravi and the seller have agreed on a price (e.g., a binding message exchange indicating acceptance of an offer). Otherwise resolve NO at the cutoff.
